say:2:1422108001:0.text: While you were on duty recently, did you let anyone pass from the royal city into the commoners' district?
say:2:1422108001:0.source_cn: 你最近执勤的时候时有没有放行从王城来到平民区的人？

say:3:1422108002:0.text: Captain! Except for the servants expelled from the royal city, no suspicious individuals were allowed to pass! Wait! No... There was one noble...
say:3:1422108002:0.source_cn: 报告大人！除了那些被驱赶出王城的仆从外，绝对没有放行任...

say:4:1422108003:0.text: He claimed to a viscount and was chasing after a runaway servant... I did not dare stop him. A thousand apologies, Captain. I should've kept him out...
say:4:1422108003:0.source_cn: 那个人穿着贵族服饰，说他是一位子爵，正在追赶家里的逃奴...

say:5:1422108004:0.text: It's alright. I understand. As you were.
